indian_sms.name: Indian scam SMS, audited (English, Hindi, Hinglish messages)

caveats: All three sets are synthetic (LLM-generated); none measures real-world accuracy.
The BothBosu sets are English and US-centred (SSN, IRS-style scams), so they test generalisation beyond India.
The SMS set is text messages, not calls; each message is judged as a single line from the sender. Its labels were audited by an AI model with a small human spot check, as its card states.
